system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Moses standing at the water's edge with his arm extended outward over the sea","action":"Moses stretches his hand over the sea as a strong east wind drives back the waters, which stand up in walls on either side of a dry sea floor","setting":"Sea of Reeds at night, a wide shallow sea with walls of water rising on both sides of a dry channel toward the hill country shore","secondaryElements":"Pillar of cloud glowing with fire hovering behind the Israelite camp; wind-bent reeds along the shore; Israelite families in plain woven wool gathered on the bank; distant Egyptian camp dim beyond the cloud","mood":"Sacred awe and solemn wonder, with a hint of dread at the power of God","timeOfDay":"Deep night, the sky just beginning to hint at the coming dawn","composition":"Wide panoramic view with Moses small in the foreground, the towering water walls framing the central dry path, the glowing cloud pillar balancing the far side"}
